name: user-message
title: User Message
description: A message the user sent, at the end of the line: where it came from over it ("Sent from queue"), its text in a muted bubble cut to 6 lines with a Clamp (how long it is, copy, open in a reader; a bar at the top while it is open and scrolled past), when it was sent and its actions under it, shown on hover or focus and always on touch screens. Files, images and links it refers to are MessageMention chips in its text, each a button opening what it refers to. A command in its text ("/review") is a MessageCommand, a chip in monospace; a message that is only a command ("/compact") is a UserMessageCommand in place of the bubble, a quiet monospace line on a hairline at its end, what it did following as the app's own (a MessageDivider). Each message has an sr-only author heading, its level a prop (h3 by default). With from, a message written by someone else folds to one line showing the app-provided icon, label and first non-empty summary line. MessageLink: a web address in its text as a link, the site's icon (`icon`) before it centred on the line in any script and apart from the text before it, a long address going on beside it and breaking anywhere. At most 9 of the conversation's 12 columns (docs/grid.md).
